title: Hong Kong educators want a social media ban for under-16s. The government says it has no plans to legislate.
summary: Hong Kong educators and a lawmaker urge under-16 social media ban. A survey found 62% of Hong Kong residents support a legislative ban, with support rising to 76% among parents.
